name: Soft Barrier Defeat
description: Barbed wire, razor wire, and concertina wire are common perimeter barrier toppers that can be defeated non-destructively by placing a thick material over the wire to protect against cuts. A wool blanket is the most practical tool for this — cheap, widely available, and providing adequate protection against standard barbed wire. Used in conjunction with fence climbing on perimeter assessments where wire topping is present.

blue.det: Physical evidence — cut or pressed-down wire; camera footage of perimeter crossing; patrol discovery.
blue.cm: Anti-climb covers making wire defeat harder; CCTV coverage of perimeter; patrol at irregular intervals; vibration sensors on fence line; razor wire combined with solid barrier below.
